text.name: stw_warn
text.text: You have worked %d hours. Only %d hours left before you must sleep.

text.name: stw_exhausted
text.text: You are exhausted after 14 hours of work. Press R to sleep.

text.name: stw_mustSleep
text.text: You are too tired to drive. Sleep first!

text.name: stw_rested
text.text: You slept %.0f hours and you are fully rested. Back to work!

text.name: stw_pressR
text.text: You are exhausted. Press R to sleep.
